description: Hand-curated original summaries, not a scrape. Verify source links and rights before production.

mechanics.name: Disguise permissions
mechanics.summary: Use disguise states to change which areas or actions are permitted. A stealth prototype can switch access permissions based on costume.

prototype_hint.godot: Use an Area2D gate and a disguise enum; log denied/allowed transitions.
prototype_hint.littlejs: Use a region trigger and actor disguise state; log access decisions.

mechanics.name: Flow splitting and ratios
mechanics.summary: Split resource flow across multiple destinations and let players experiment with throughput and bottlenecks.

prototype_hint.godot: Model sources, splitters and sinks as nodes; test conserved input totals.
prototype_hint.littlejs: Simulate fixed-timestep item flow and render branching tracks.

mechanics.name: Crew a shared vehicle
mechanics.summary: Give multiple players different controls on a single vehicle; coordination becomes the core challenge.

prototype_hint.godot: Create independent steering and power inputs on one CharacterBody2D; record cooperation events.
prototype_hint.littlejs: Map two controls to steering and thrust on one shared entity; record input timing.
